items: When the number of moles of reactants and products in balanced chemical equations are equal, then units are canceled out, and equilibrium constant does not have any unit.

blocks.text: The ester formation reaction happens in solution state, and number of moles of reactants and products are equal. The Kc will have no units.

blocks.latex: K_c = \frac{[\ce{CH3COOC2H5}]\,[\ce{H2O}]}{[\ce{CH3COOH_{(aq)}}]\,[\ce{C2H5OH_{(aq)}}]} = \frac{\text{mol dm}^{-3} \times \text{mol dm}^{-3}}{\text{mol dm}^{-3} \times \text{mol dm}^{-3}} = \text{no units}
blocks.text_alt: Kc = [CH₃COOC₂H₅][H₂O] / [CH₃COOH(aq)][C₂H₅OH(aq)] = (mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³) / (mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³) = no units

items: When the number of moles are unequal, then value of equilibrium constant depend upon the units of reactants and products used. In the synthesis of NH₃ by Haber’s process, the units of reactants and products are not cancelled.
